whatToWatch.text: Seattle rolls into Santa Clara at 6-4 with two straight wins — a true road test against the 49ers, and the kind of game that tells you what this team actually is.
The defense is the headliner: 17.5 points allowed per game and 2.7 sacks a night, both better than San Francisco's 21.8 and 1.78. If that edge holds up on the road, the Hawks are in great shape.

Attrition is real — four Seahawks are out (Leonard Williams, Quenton Nelson and Charles Cross among the names on the report) with one more questionable, while SF has just one out. Depth guys will have to step up in a hostile building.

newsBlurb.text: Seattle emerges from the bye with its defense riding a hot stretch and a win over the Raiders still fresh on the tape — now it heads to San Francisco to prove the layoff sharpened rather than stalled it. The quarterback conversation hasn't quieted, and neither have the health questions coaches spent the week sorting through. Answers come fast on the road against the Niners.
